verdict.rationale: Paystack's API docs describe separate test and live environments, selected by which API keys you use: test keys for development and testing, live keys for production. This is a genuine isolated sandbox environment, not just a dry-run flag. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that test-mode data is isolated from live data, details on test credentials or simulated payment scenarios, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Use your test keys for development and testing, and your live keys for production.
This works for both test and live environments. Your API keys determine which environment you're using.
